name: LoopActivity
label: Loop
description: Use this to keep doing something again and again, as long as certain conditions are met.

fields.name: LoopType
fields.label: Repeat Method
fields.description: Select how the steps should repeat: either while something is true, or once for each item in a list.

selectOptions.label: Repeat based on condition
selectOptions.description: Keep running the steps again and again, as long as something is true.

selectOptions.label: Repeat for every item in a list
selectOptions.description: Do the steps once for each item in a list.

selectOptions.label: Is Equal To
selectOptions.description: Checks if the first value is equal to the second value.

selectOptions.label: Is Not Equal To
selectOptions.description: Checks if the first value is not equal to the second value.

selectOptions.label: Text Starts With
selectOptions.description: Checks if the text starts with the given value.

selectOptions.label: Text Does Not Start With
selectOptions.description: Checks if the text does not start with the given value.

selectOptions.label: Text Ends With
selectOptions.description: Checks if the text ends with the given value.

selectOptions.label: Text Does Not End With
selectOptions.description: Checks if the text does not end with the given value.

selectOptions.label: Text Contains
selectOptions.description: Checks if the text contains the given value.

selectOptions.label: Text Does Not Contain
selectOptions.description: Checks if the text does not contain the given value.

selectOptions.label: List Contains
selectOptions.description: Checks if the list contains the given item.

selectOptions.label: List Does Not Contain
selectOptions.description: Checks if the list does not contain the given item.

selectOptions.label: Is List Empty
selectOptions.description: Checks if the list is empty.

selectOptions.label: Is List Not Empty
selectOptions.description: Checks if the list is not empty.

selectOptions.label: Is Greater Than
selectOptions.description: Checks if the first value is greater than the second value.

selectOptions.label: Is Less Than
selectOptions.description: Checks if the first value is less than the second value.

selectOptions.label: Is Greater Than Or Equal To
selectOptions.description: Checks if the first value is greater than or equal to the second value.

selectOptions.label: Is Less Than Or Equal To
selectOptions.description: Checks if the first value is less than or equal to the second value.

selectOptions.label: File Exists
selectOptions.description: Checks if the file exists.

selectOptions.label: File Does Not Exist
selectOptions.description: Checks if the file does not exist.

fields.name: ListVariableName
fields.label: Items to Loop Through
fields.description: Pick the list you want to go through one item at a time.

fields.name: ItemVariableName
fields.label: Current Item Variable Name
fields.description: The name of the variable that will hold the current item in the list during each iteration.

fields.name: ItemIndexVariableName
fields.label: Current Item Index Variable Name
fields.description: The name of the variable that will hold the current item index in the list during each iteration.
